what: The list of built-in attribute names now has three homes: hir-expand's INERT_ATTRIBUTES (tied to intern's declared symbols), hir-ty's own INERT_ATTRIBUTES string list, and blaze-front-items' NAMES. The bottom step of the new front end needs the names and sits under hir-expand, so it could not read the table and I copied it.
cost: a third copy; one test (`the_built_in_names_are_the_old_front_ends`) holds it equal to hir-expand's
cause: the table lives in a crate above the code that needs it, and its rows carry interned symbols a bottom crate cannot name
prevention: move the names to the bottom crate (blaze-front-items::builtin) and build hir-expand's table and hir-ty's list from it; ban the copies
